text: Summarise how this repo builds and releases.

**Build and release:**

- `make app` builds a side-by-side "Anywhere Dev.app". `make run` makes a release build.
- A `v*` tag triggers `release-mac.yml`, which builds a universal app, notarizes it, signs the Sparkle update and uploads the DMG and `appcast.xml` to GitHub Releases.
- Every PR needs exactly one `type:` label.
- `changelog-draft.sh` drafts the changelog. The release script refuses a tag with no changelog section.

**Things to check:**

- Tags go up to v0.1.5, but the top `CHANGELOG.md` entry is 0.1.4.
- No `.anywhere/` directory is checked in. The setup/teardown script feature exists, but this repo has no scripts of its own.

**Recent work:** the last 30 commits are PRs #40–#66. They cover sidebar and project UX (groups, pins, emoji, clone from URL, composer), multiple Claude/Codex accounts, the PR card and fix-checks flow, terminal polish, `.anywhere/config.json` scripts and release tooling.

All three agents have finished. This is the `pocket` UI crate summary.

**Composition:**

- `Desktop` (`crates/pocket/src/desktop.rs`) is the single root GPUI entity. It holds about 70 fields, most of them feature state structs.
